threads.title: 👋 Welcome to Vibe Garage: start here + house rules
threads.bodyHTML:
👋 Welcome to Vibe Garage, a cozy late-night hangout for people who build with AI. Half-finished is welcome here, and nobody gets roasted for not knowing what a pointer is.

Website: https://vibegarage.neozonesproductions.com/

How it works

  • Share a project: use the Submit form. It checks for leaked API keys, then posts your project on Vibe Garage under your account display name.
  • Forum channels: the forum runs on GitHub Discussions, with Show & Tell, Help Me Unstick, Prompt Craft, Tools & Models, Newbie Corner and Off-Topic Lounge.
  • Feedback level: every post says what kind of feedback the author wants: 💜 Just vibes (hype only), 🌱 Gentle tips (kind suggestions), or 🔥 Tear it apart (honest, never personal). Please respect it.

House rules (short on purpose)

  1. Be kind, always. Assume good intent. Everyone started somewhere.
  2. No gatekeeping, no skill-shaming. Building with AI is real building. Beginner questions are explicitly welcome.
  3. Respect the feedback level the author asked for.
  4. Lift people up. Use reactions generously; mark helpful answers.
  5. Keep secrets secret. Never post API keys, passwords or personal data.
  6. Credit and honesty. Say where code, assets or ideas came from.
  7. Reporting is easy. Use the ··· menu on any post → Report content. The founder will take a look.
  8. Volunteer moderator roles will open as the community grows.

Full guidelines: https://vibegarage.neozonesproductions.com/guidelines.html

Say hi below: what are you building this week? ✨
